description: This PHP script manages bug issue creation, linking, and note addition in the context of a test management and issue tracking integration within the TestLink project. It handles form processing, user permissions, and interactions with external issue trackers.

methods.name: initEnv
methods.description: Initializes the environment by processing user input, setting up GUI variables, and managing user session state.

methods.name: getIssueTracker
methods.description: Retrieves the issue tracker interface object and configuration based on project settings.

methods.name: getDirectLinkToExec
methods.description: Generates a direct URL link to a specific test execution based on database data.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks whether the current user has permission to view/test execute on the project.
